faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Kalyani Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before 5 PM on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree in Applied Sociology from a recognized university or institute. A Ph.D. in the respective discipline is considered desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Guest Faculty position is 64 years as of 01 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. How will the candidates be selected for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Faculty of Applied Sociology post will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty role?
faq.answer: The remuneration for the Guest Faculty is Rs 1000/- per class/per hour, with a maximum limit of 60 hours during the Academic Session.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through email. Candidates need to send their duly filled application form and relevant documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q7. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: You need to submit a scan copy of the duly filled application form along with relevant certificates (age, qualifications, experience) and a colored passport size photograph.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of AIIMS Kalyani, which is www.aiimskalyani.edu.in.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the walk-in date mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: The notification mentions a walk-in date of 05th October 2026, which is likely the date for the interview.
